page0: Fully take advantage of all the studios and the render studio pipelines for making the 8 hours videos they produce veryyy good visual results and i want this quality in the entire MOOR presentation so lets use the lessons we already learned design a plan, use appropriate tools to make this Environment Engine for Canonical presentation advancement and build it and push it to pulse and have it use the funnel as a source of truth for advancement
title: Environment Engine — Canonical Presentation Advancement
objective: Turn the visual lessons already proven by MOOR's ambient studios and long-form render pipeline into a reusable, Funnel-governed presentation engine that can raise the quality floor of MOOR surfaces without copying entire studios or making presentation itself an authority source.

authority.rule: The Environment Engine may propose and render presentation recipes. Only a valid Funnel-backed advancement contract may promote a presentation rule or canonical revision.

source_lessons.rule: A high-quality presentation must be replayable from compact state; seed, camera and time are first-class.
Presentation begins with explicit spatial layers, not a flat background plus UI.
Lighting, occlusion and depth are structural presentation systems.
Scale and cohesion come from atmospheric layers that relate foreground to distance.
Surface response should communicate material; raw flat color is an intentional exception, not the default.
A restrained final grade unifies independently generated layers.
Subtle deterministic motion makes a presentation feel alive; it must pause and respect reduced motion.
Long output needs deterministic fixed-step time, encoder diagnostics, bounded render segments and media proof rather than screen-capture hope.
Keep exact recipes, inspect real rendered outcomes, preserve failures, and do not promote presentation changes from attention metrics or taste guesses alone.

subsystems: deterministic WebGL2 presentation renderer with Canvas2D fallback

long_form.reason: The inspected shared studio controller currently clamps one render job to 3600 seconds. Environment Engine v1 preserves that proven boundary instead of silently weakening it.
long_form.non_claim: Environment Engine v1 does not claim automatic concatenation of the eight MP4 segments into one file.

advancement_contract.advancement_rule: A score, model opinion, pretty render, or developer confidence cannot promote a new canonical presentation revision. Every required gate must be true under this contract and the governing Funnel must remain the source of truth.
advancement_contract.evidence_policy: Visual taste may be opinionated. Evidence must identify who or what observed the result, the viewport/device or render path, and which requirement it supports.

pulse.purpose: Use the engine as a canonical presentation workbench and source-law inspector inside Project Pulse.

rollout: Build Environment Engine as a reusable recipe + renderer, not as another isolated full studio.
Register it in Pulse and preserve it across Pulse rebuilds.
Use it first on new or actively redesigned MOOR presentation surfaces.
For each adoption, compile a surface-specific recipe and keep functional information hierarchy separate from decorative environment layers.
Inspect desktop/mobile and reduced-motion render outcomes before promoting that surface's presentation revision.
Bank useful outcomes and failures as Funnel/reference evidence so later presentation revisions start from accumulated truth.
done_criteria: All eight ambient studios are represented by source-backed reusable lessons.
Same input seed/profile produces byte-equivalent Environment Engine recipe JSON.
The default eight-hour output plan contains eight bounded one-hour deterministic segments with absolute time offsets.
A missing advancement gate blocks canonical promotion.
The WebGL presentation field exposes eight depth layers, atmosphere, water/reflection, environmental motion, post grade and reduced-motion pause with a Canvas2D fallback.
Pulse can open Environment Engine as an independent component and future Pulse rebuilds preserve its manifest entry.
The sealed Funnel kernel can replay Page 0 and issue a valid receipt for this blueprint in an executable test.
Documentation names the verified source boundaries and does not claim universal retrofitting or one-file eight-hour muxing.
honest_limits: Environment Engine v1 raises and codifies a presentation quality floor; it does not automatically rewrite every existing MOOR screen.
Its preview renderer is a reusable presentation field, not a replacement for full geometry engines such as the richer individual studios.
The shared inspected long-form controller is verified at up to one hour per render job; eight-hour output is planned as eight deterministic segments.
A rendered result may still require human visual inspection; passing code/tests alone does not establish beauty.
Funnel authority remains outside the Environment Engine. The engine cannot mint its own promotion authority.
